name: Business Proposal
description: Writes structured business proposals with executive summary, scope of work, pricing, timeline, and next steps for client-facing or vendor engagements. Use when the user needs to write a business proposal, service proposal, or client engagement document. Do NOT use for internal project proposals (use `project-proposal`), academic grant proposals (use `grant-proposal-writing`), or RFP responses (use `rfp-response`).
